say: Healing scriptures for sleep. Close your eyes, and let God's word go over you tonight.
small: Close your eyes. Let the Word go over you.

say: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise. Jeremiah seventeen, verse fourteen.
big: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.

say: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds. Psalm one forty seven, verse three.
big: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

say: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; Psalm one oh three, verse three.
big: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

say: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed. Isaiah fifty three, verse five.
big: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

say: Lord, whatever's hurting tonight, in the body or in the heart, I'm putting it in your hands. In Jesus' name, amen.
